We are pleased to offer you an internship at SmartSkale (www.smartskale.tech). After reviewing your profile, we believe you will be a valuable addition to our team. This letter outlines the key terms of your internship engagement.

1. Internship Details

Role / Title: {{ role }}
Department: {{ department }}
Start Date: {{ date }}
End Date: IN 3-Month
Work Mode: Remote
Working Hours: Flexible / Outcome-Based

2. Compensation

This internship is currently unpaid / no monetary stipend. SmartSkale provides the following non-monetary benefits:

  • Hands-on exposure to live SaaS products and real client projects
  • Mentorship from experienced founders and senior developers
  • Certificate of Completion upon successful internship completion
  • Letter of Recommendation (on performance merit)
  • Opportunity for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance and business needs.
  • Access to SmartSkale's internal learning resources and tools

Note: A compensation addendum may be issued separately at the company's discretion.

3. Roles & Responsibilities

As a {{ role }} at SmartSkale, you will be expected to:

  • Create engaging posters, presentations, and promotional creatives for workshops, events, and courses.
  • Design and publish content for LinkedIn, Instagram, and other social media platforms.
  • Contribute to content ideation, branding activities, and campaign planning.
  • Support workshop and course promotions through creative marketing initiatives.
  • Assist in basic video editing, reels creation, and short-form content production.
  • Stay updated with current social media trends, design styles, and digital marketing practices.
  • Collaborate with the team during meetings, brainstorming sessions, and campaign reviews.
  • Maintain consistency in branding, communication, and content quality across platforms.
  • Complete assigned tasks and campaign deliverables within agreed timelines.
  • Take ownership of assigned work and actively contribute ideas to improve engagement and reach.

4. Terms & Conditions

  • This offer is contingent upon signing the Internship Agreement and NDA.
  • The internship does not constitute an employment relationship.
  • SmartSkale reserves the right to terminate this engagement with 15 days' written notice.
  • All work produced during the internship is the intellectual property of SmartSkale.
  • The intern is expected to maintain confidentiality of all proprietary information.

5. Acceptance

Please sign and return a copy of this letter within 1 week of receiving it to confirm your acceptance. Failure to respond may result in withdrawal of the offer.

We look forward to welcoming you to the SmartSkale family and wish you a productive and enriching internship experience.

4. Intellectual Property

All work, code, designs, documentation, ideas, and any other intellectual output created by the Intern during the internship period, whether individually or in collaboration, shall be the sole and exclusive property of SmartSkale. The Intern hereby assigns all such rights to SmartSkale and waives any moral rights therein.

The Intern shall not use, reproduce, or distribute any such work without prior written consent of SmartSkale.

5. Confidentiality

The Intern agrees to keep strictly confidential all information relating to SmartSkale's business, products, clients, technology, strategies, and operations. This obligation shall survive termination of this Agreement for 2 (two) years. A separate Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) shall be executed alongside this Agreement.

6. Code of Conduct

  • Maintain professionalism and respectful communication with all team members
  • Not engage in any activity that may damage SmartSkale's reputation or interests
  • Not taking up competing internships or employment without prior written disclosure
  • Not sharing or publishing any internal information on social media or public forums
  • Adhere to data privacy norms and handle client/user data with utmost care

7. Termination

Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing 15 (fifteen) days' written notice. SmartSkale may terminate immediately in cases of gross misconduct, breach of confidentiality, IP violation, or any act detrimental to the company's interests.

8. Certificate of Completion

Upon successful completion of the internship and fulfilment of all assigned responsibilities, SmartSkale shall issue an official Certificate of Internship Completion within 15 working days of the end date.

9. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in Gautam Buddha Nagar (Greater Noida), Uttar Pradesh, India.

10. Entire Agreement

This Agreement, together with the Offer Letter and NDA, constitutes the entire understanding between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions.
